beats.text: SOP Lang circuits are proposed as executable structures with explicit contracts and receipts.

beats.text: Their value depends on retaining the meanings of operations and dependencies.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A declaration names a produced value and the command that produces it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Later declarations can consume that value through explicit references.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Revision creates a new value instead of silently replacing the old one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The language also distinguishes consuming a value from inspecting its runtime identity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That handle can expose producer information, alternatives, provenance, or validation status.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The distinction matters when a result must be challenged or replayed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The technical chapter develops these details without demanding one grammar for every scientific command.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A large knowledge collection should not become one enormous active computation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed runtime keeps persistent declarations and indexed capabilities separate from request-time circuits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A particular question activates the fragments and methods it actually needs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Dependencies can then grow as new values make other operations applicable.
